rationale: The agent executed multiple order- and account-changing writes (updating shipping addresses on two orders, updating default user address, and exchanging an item with a payment method) without first authenticating the user and without obtaining explicit confirmation before each change, both required by policy. It also updated both pending orders’ addresses even though the user indicated only one order was misaddressed, risking an unnecessary/incorrect change. The exchange to the “cheapest tablet” was not validated or confirmed (no evidence the agent identified the cheapest model or confirmed pricing/fees), and the agent asserted all changes were completed without showing confirmations of success. These constitute policy violations (writes without confirmation; inadequate authentication) and potential inaccuracies about what should have been changed.
